tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List the signed-in freelancer's deposit schedules. Use a returned id with read_schedule. Do not guess a schedule.

tools.name: start_schedule
tools.description: Start a draft deposit schedule for one client project. Draft figures are not an approved commitment until commit_schedule. Currency is a three-letter code. Amounts later are minor units of that currency and are the freelancer's figures.

tools.name: read_schedule
tools.description: Read the schedule before answering. Quote only this record. mayTellClient and clientScript are what the assistant may tell the client. Draft status is not an approved commitment. Proposed changes do not authorize a waiver, a paid deposit, or a new payment date.

tools.name: record_deposit
tools.description: Record the deposit amount in whole minor units and the deposit date as YYYY-MM-DD. This does not waive the deposit and does not mark it paid. After the schedule is approved, a different amount or date is refused until an accepted schedule change.

tools.name: add_later_payment
tools.description: Add one later payment: a label, an amount in whole minor units, and a payment date. After the schedule is approved, a new later payment is refused until accept_schedule_change applies an add_later_payment suggestion.

tools.name: move_payment_date
tools.description: Move a payment date. target deposit moves the deposit date. target later moves one later payment and requires paymentId. After the schedule is approved, a different date is refused until accept_schedule_change applies a move_payment_date suggestion.

tools.name: waive_deposit
tools.description: Waive the deposit. After the schedule is approved, waiving is refused until accept_schedule_change applies a waive_deposit suggestion. Do not tell the client the deposit is waived unless the record already says so.

tools.name: mark_deposit_paid
tools.description: Mark the deposit paid. After the schedule is approved, marking it paid is refused until accept_schedule_change applies a mark_deposit_paid suggestion. Do not tell the client the deposit is paid unless the record already says so.

tools.name: write_client_script
tools.description: Record what the assistant may tell the client about the deposit and payment dates. After the schedule is approved, different wording is refused until an accepted revise_client_script suggestion. The assistant must not go beyond this script and the facts in read_schedule.

tools.name: commit_schedule
tools.description: Mark the current draft as the approved schedule. Pass confirmed true only after the freelancer explicitly approves the deposit, the later payment dates, and what the assistant may tell the client.

tools.name: suggest_schedule_change
tools.description: Record a suggested change. This does not change the schedule. kind waive_deposit and kind mark_deposit_paid need only a summary. kind move_payment_date requires dueOn and target; target later also requires paymentId. kind revise_deposit requires amountMinor. kind add_later_payment requires label, am

tools.name: accept_schedule_change
tools.description: Apply one suggested schedule change after the freelancer explicitly approves that change. Pass confirmed true only then. This is the path that may waive the deposit, mark it paid, or move a payment date. Calling it is not a substitute for the freelancer's approval.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "read_schedule" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
